description: Two installs of the same pack land by different routes and both record their provenance. The registry-mediated install records MKT-094's pin plus the content_digest and key_id of the MKT-009a envelope that actually verified, plus the resolved entry's own CHI-021 digest. The direct, out-of-band artifact install records the same verified provenance, names the direct path as its source, and carries NO trust_channel — so it has no (pack_id, trust channel) pair to auto-track (MKT-090) and a host must not supply one. Without these members nothing on the box answers 'which key vouched for the bytes that are running': MKT-009a requires the envelope to be dropped at install and never persisted, so the answer is unreconstructable from the installed pack afterwards.
